title: Middle school geometry: measure and reason
description: Four lessons from perimeter and area to angle reasoning, volume and symmetry: compute, justify, and transfer to real shapes.
assumptions: Whole-number lengths and angles; pi approximated as 3 where needed. No apparatus needed.
stage1goal: Build measure formulas from unit squares.
stage2goal: Reason about angles, volume and symmetry.
perimeter-area.title: Perimeter vs area
perimeter-area.reading: Perimeter adds side lengths; area counts unit squares: rectangle P = 2(l+w), A = l×w.
perimeter-area.worked.prompt: Why is area l×w but perimeter 2(l+w)?
perimeter-area.worked.fb: Area covers rows of w squares; perimeter walks the boundary.
triangle-angles.title: Triangle angles sum to 180
triangle-angles.goal: Use the angle-sum to find missing angles.
triangle-angles.reading: The three interior angles of any triangle sum to 180°; a right angle is 90°.
triangle-angles.struggle: Without measuring, explain why a triangle cannot have two right angles.
triangle-angles.worked.prompt: Why can a triangle not have two right angles?
triangle-angles.worked.content: Two right angles already use the whole 180°.
triangle-angles.transfer-right.prompt: A right triangle has one 35° angle. The other acute angle?
volume.title: Volume: layers of unit cubes
volume.goal: Compute volume as layers of unit cubes.
volume.reading: Volume counts unit cubes: box V = l×w×h; each layer is l×w cubes.
volume.worked.fb: h layers each holding l×w cubes.
volume.transfer-water.prompt: A tank 10×10×10 cm is half full. Water volume?
symmetry.title: Symmetry and coordinates
symmetry.goal: Identify line symmetry and reflect points.
symmetry.reading: A line of symmetry folds a shape onto itself; reflecting (x,y) over the y-axis gives (-x,y).
symmetry.worked.prompt: What does a line of symmetry do?
symmetry.worked.fb: Folds the shape so halves match exactly.
symmetry.worked.content: A square has 4 lines of symmetry.
symmetry.transfer-letter.prompt: Which letter has a vertical line of symmetry?
symmetry.transfer-letter.a.label: F
symmetry.transfer-letter.b.label: A
